WITH scorecards_base AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    COALESCE(s.dataset_id::text, '') AS dataset_id2
  FROM scorecards AS s
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND s.facility_id IN ($facility_id)
    AND s.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
),

conducted_scope AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scorecards_base
  WHERE $__timeFilter(conducted_date)
    AND dataset_id2 IN ($dataset_id)
),

planned_scope AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scorecards_base
  WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
    AND dataset_id2 IN ($dataset_id)
),

total_planned AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS "Total Planned"
  FROM planned_scope
),

total_in_review AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS "Total In Review"
  FROM conducted_scope
  WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    AND completed_at IS NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL
),

total_conducted AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS "Total Conducted"
  FROM conducted_scope
  WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL OR rejected_at IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
  concat_ws(
    ' / ',
    (SELECT * FROM total_planned),
    (SELECT * FROM total_in_review),
    (SELECT * FROM total_conducted)
  ) AS summary

WITH scorecards_base AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    COALESCE(s.dataset_id::text, '') AS dataset_id2,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (s.finished_date - s.conducted_date)) / 86400 AS conducted_period
  FROM scorecards AS s
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(s.conducted_date)
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND s.facility_id IN ($facility_id)
    AND s.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM participants AS p
      WHERE p.scorecard_uuid = s.id::varchar(20)
    )
),

total_late_insert AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS "Total Conducted"
  FROM scorecards_base
  WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND rejected_at IS NULL
    AND conducted_period > 0
    AND dataset_id2 IN ($dataset_id)
)

SELECT
  concat_ws(
    ' / ',
    (SELECT * FROM total_late_insert)
  ) AS summary

WITH covered_locations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.province_id,
    d.district_id,
    d.commune_id
  FROM scorecards AS s
  INNER JOIN datasets AS d ON s.dataset_id = d.id
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(s.conducted_date)
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND d.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.rejected_at IS NULL
),

target_locations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.province_id,
    d.district_id,
    d.commune_id
  FROM scorecards AS s
  INNER JOIN datasets AS d ON s.dataset_id = d.id
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(s.created_at)
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND d.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.rejected_at IS NULL
),

summary AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT province_id) FROM covered_locations) AS provinces_covered,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT province_id) FROM target_locations) AS provinces_target,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT district_id) FROM covered_locations) AS districts_covered,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT district_id) FROM target_locations) AS districts_target,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT commune_id) FROM covered_locations) AS communes_covered,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT commune_id) FROM target_locations) AS communes_target
)

SELECT '$province_covered' AS "$location",
  concat(provinces_covered, '/', provinces_target) AS "$covered_vs_target",
  concat(ROUND((provinces_covered::numeric / NULLIF(provinces_target, 0)) * 100, 2), '%') AS "$coverage_rate"
FROM summary

UNION ALL

SELECT '$district_covered' AS "$location",
  concat(districts_covered, '/', districts_target) AS "$covered_vs_target",
  concat(ROUND((districts_covered::numeric / NULLIF(districts_target, 0)) * 100, 2), '%') AS "$coverage_rate"
FROM summary

UNION ALL

SELECT '$commune_covered' AS "$location",
  concat(communes_covered, '/', communes_target) AS "$covered_vs_target",
  concat(ROUND((communes_covered::numeric / NULLIF(communes_target, 0)) * 100, 2), '%') AS "$coverage_rate"
FROM summary

WITH conducted_scope AS (
  SELECT
    CEIL(
      EXTRACT(epoch FROM (s.completed_at - s.conducted_date)) / 86400 * 2
    ) / 2 AS duration
  FROM scorecards AS s
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(s.conducted_date)
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND s.facility_id IN ($facility_id)
    AND s.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(s.dataset_id::text, '') IN ($dataset_id)
)

SELECT
  min(duration)::integer AS "$min_day",
  avg(duration)::integer AS "$average_day",
  max(duration)::integer AS "$max_day"
FROM conducted_scope;

WITH _scorecards AS (
  SELECT 
    s.*,
    concat_ws(
      '',
      (CASE WHEN s.dataset_id IS NULL THEN '' END),
      (CASE WHEN s.dataset_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.dataset_id END)
    ) AS dataset_id2
  FROM scorecards AS s
  WHERE 
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})
    AND $__timeFilter(s.created_at)
    AND s.scorecard_type IN ($scorecard_type)
    AND s.year IN ($year)
    AND s.facility_id IN ($facility_id)
    AND s.province_id IN ($province_id)
    AND s.local_ngo_id IN ($local_ngo_id)
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
),

_filtered_scorecards AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM _scorecards s
  WHERE s.dataset_id2 IN ($dataset_id)
),

_total_submitted AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_submitted
  FROM _filtered_scorecards
  WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL
),

_total_approved AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_approved
  FROM _filtered_scorecards
  WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
),

_total_rejected AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_rejected
  FROM _filtered_scorecards
  WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL
),

_total_custom_indicator_correction AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_custom_indicator_correction
  FROM raised_indicators AS ri
  INNER JOIN indicators AS i ON ri.indicator_uuid = i.uuid
  INNER JOIN _filtered_scorecards AS s ON ri.scorecard_uuid = s.id::varchar(20)
  WHERE 
    i.type = 'Indicators::CustomIndicator'
    AND ri.updated_at > ri.created_at
)

SELECT
  (SELECT total_submitted FROM _total_submitted) AS "$total_submitted_scorecard",
  (SELECT total_approved FROM _total_approved) AS "$total_approved_scorecard",
  (SELECT total_rejected FROM _total_rejected) AS "$total_rejected_scorecard",
  (SELECT total_custom_indicator_correction FROM _total_custom_indicator_correction) AS "$total_custom_indicator_correction"

WITH scorecards_base AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM scorecards AS s
  WHERE
    s.program_id IN (${program_id})

    AND s.completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.rejected_at IS NULL

),

participants_scope AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM participants AS p
  WHERE p.countable = true
    AND p.scorecard_uuid::integer IN (SELECT id FROM scorecards_base)
),

totals AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) AS total_participant,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'female') AS total_female,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE youth = true)      AS total_youth,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE disability = true) AS total_disability,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE minority = true)   AS total_minority
  FROM participants_scope
)

SELECT
  total_participant AS "$total_participants",
  concat(total_female, ' (', ROUND(total_female::numeric / NULLIF(total_participant, 0) * 100, 0), '%)') AS "$female_percentage",
  concat(total_youth, ' (', ROUND(total_youth::numeric / NULLIF(total_participant, 0) * 100, 0), '%)') AS "$youth_percentage",
  concat(total_disability, ' (', ROUND(total_disability::numeric / NULLIF(total_participant, 0) * 100, 0), '%)') AS "$disabilities_percentage",
  concat(total_minority, ' (', ROUND(total_minority::numeric / NULLIF(total_participant, 0) * 100, 0), '%)') AS "$minority_percentage"
FROM totals;
